qualifier: SREBP sterol plus ATF6/CREB3 ER-stress arms
name: SREBP sterol and ATF6/CREB3 ER-stress transcriptional activation
rationale: All members concern ER-anchored transcription factors released to drive genes (SREBP for cholesterol homeostasis, ATF6/CREB3 for chaperones); the ATF6/CREB3 unfolded protein response arm is what the cholesterol-regulation confusables lack.

qualifier: HIF signalling with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic input
name: HIF hypoxia signalling and glycolytic metabolic reprogramming
rationale: Members cover HIF oxygen sensing, hypoxia and control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate and nucleotide catabolism (with p53/mTORC1 metabolic sets); HIF/hypoxia distinguishes it from glycolysis-enzyme confusables and the absence of NFE2L2 from the NRF2 confusables.

qualifier: exogenous peptide loading and its regulation
name: Exogenous peptide antigen presentation via MHC class II
rationale: All members describe processing, loading and regulation of exogenous peptide presentation on MHC class II, distinguishing it from MHC class I cross-presentation, lipid/class Ib presentation and DC surface-signature confusables.

qualifier: chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation (bone formation, not resorption)
name: Cartilage and bone formation by chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation
rationale: Members span cartilage and bone development, ossification, chondrocyte and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation and RUNX2 control; the bone-forming cell focus distinguishes it from osteoclast/remodelling and ECM-secretion confusables.

qualifier: gap-junction coupling and synaptic calcium-channel regulation
name: Neuronal gap-junction coupling and presynaptic calcium-channel regulation
rationale: Members combine connexon assembly and electrical transmission with calcium entry regulation, metabotropic glutamate signalling and presynaptic structure in neural signalling; the connexon/gap-junction plus calcium-channel combination separates it from purely presynaptic or purely gap-junction confusables.

qualifier: sodium-calcium exchange and calcium-triggered release
name: Cardiomyocyte calcium handling via sodium-calcium exchange and calcium-triggered release
rationale: Members concern cytosolic calcium control in cardiac muscle (Na/Ca exchangers, sequestered calcium release, membrane potential); responses to calcium/caffeine and calcium-channel activation distinguish it from SERCA/relaxation and ryanodine-inhibition confusables.

qualifier: melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis, light response
name: Melanin pigmentation and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members cover melanin synthesis, melanosome assembly/maturation and related organelles (platelet dense granules, AP-3 coated vesicles) plus light responses; organelle biogenesis distinguishes it from MITF-M non-pigment target and organelle-acidification confusables.

qualifier: fork reversal, DNA topology and recombination-based telomere maintenance
name: Replication fork stress and recombinational telomere maintenance
rationale: Members address stalled-fork processing, DNA topological change, R-loops and recombination-based telomere maintenance; fork/topology responses distinguish it from telomere-capping and DNA damage checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: aspartate transport and excitatory amino acid transporter disease
name: Aspartate transport and excitatory amino acid transporter defects
rationale: All members involve glutamate/aspartate transporters (SLC1A1, SLC1A3, SLC17A8) or aspartate membrane transport; aspartate and transporter disease variants distinguish it from astrocytic glutamate reuptake and GABA confusables.

qualifier: NAD(P) and coenzyme A with pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion
name: NAD(P) and coenzyme A metabolism with pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion
rationale: Members cover NAD/NADP synthesis, salvage, transport and NADPH regeneration, CoA/pantothenate synthesis and PDH-catalysed acetyl-CoA formation; the pyridine nucleotide arm distinguishes it from TCA, OGDH/lipoylation and thiamine confusables.

qualifier: RAB/RAS prenylation and Porcupine Wnt acylation
name: RAB/RAS prenylation and Porcupine-mediated Wnt lipidation
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins: geranylgeranylation of RAB and RAS processing plus PORCN acylation in Wnt secretion; prenylation and Wnt lipidation distinguish it from Hedgehog palmitoylation and phospholipid-transfer confusables.

qualifier: pesticides, dioxin/aryl hydrocarbon receptor, ethanol and nicotine
name: Responses to organic xenobiotics: pesticides, dioxins, ethanol, nicotine
rationale: Members are cellular responses to environmental organic chemicals (pesticides, dioxin via AhR, bisphenol A, ethanol, nicotine, anaesthetics); organic toxicants distinguish it from metal-ion, vitamin and anticancer-drug response confusables.

qualifier: ABCA1-mediated cholesterol and phospholipid efflux
name: ABCA1-mediated cholesterol and phospholipid efflux in HDL assembly
rationale: Members describe ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol and phospholipid efflux forming HDL, under LXR control; nascent HDL assembly distinguishes it from HDL/LDL remodelling, clearance and cholesterol uptake confusables.

core: Nuclear receptor transcriptional control of metabolism
qualifier: LXR targets in lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis
name: LXR transcriptional control of lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) target gene programmes and nuclear receptor transcription/SUMOylation; LXR-specific gene regulation distinguishes it from PPAR/clock, lipid droplet and adipogenesis confusables.

qualifier: zinc, copper, manganese transport and metallothionein detoxification
name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and metallothionein detoxification
rationale: Members cover SLC30/SLC39 zinc and copper/manganese/cadmium transport, MTF1 and metallothionein responses and metal detoxification; non-iron metals distinguish it from iron/heme and lead/selenium response confusables.

qualifier: white fat cell proliferation and PPAR signalling regulation
name: White adipose expansion and PPAR signalling regulation
rationale: Members concern white fat cell proliferation, fat pad and adipose development and up/down regulation of PPAR signalling and thermogenesis; proliferation/expansion rather than differentiation distinguishes it from adipogenesis and brown/beige confusables.

qualifier: pneumocyte differentiation and perinatal adaptation
name: Perinatal alveolar surfactant homeostasis and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover surfactant metabolism and its disorders, type I/II pneumocyte differentiation, saccule development, hyperoxia and ductus closure at birth; surfactant/alveolar focus distinguishes it from lung branching, airway epithelium and gas-transport confusables.

qualifier: cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptors with cAMP control
name: Cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptor neurotransmission
rationale: Members are nicotinic/muscarinic acetylcholine, serotonin and adenosine receptor signalling with cholinergic transmission and cAMP regulation; acetylcholine and adenosine receptors distinguish it from tachykinin, histamine/serotonin synthesis and adrenergic confusables.

qualifier: urea cycle, sulfur amino acid and glutathione metabolism with inborn errors
name: Amino acid, urea cycle and glutathione metabolism
rationale: Members span amino acid synthesis and catabolism, urea cycle and its disorders, transsulfuration, glutathione and cofactor (B6, BH4) metabolism; nitrogen/amino acid handling distinguishes it from selenium, gluconeogenesis, malate-aspartate shuttle and TCA confusables.

qualifier: collagen/VWF adhesion receptors GPVI and GPIb-IX-V
name: Adhesion-receptor platelet activation via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, adhesion and aggregation; adhesion-receptor (collagen GPVI, GPIb-IX-V) signalling distinguishes it from soluble-agonist GPCR (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane) and VWF-variant/degranulation confusables.

qualifier: paracetamol, CYP2E1 oxidation and N-acetylation
name: CYP2E1 oxidation and N-acetylation of paracetamol and aromatics
rationale: Members describe phase I/II metabolism of paracetamol and nitrogenous aromatic compounds via CYP2E1 and acetylation; these routes distinguish it from glycine-conjugation, methylation/sulfonation and CYP1A2 confusables.

qualifier: NRF2 oxidative-stress plus HIF hypoxia responses
name: NRF2 oxidative-stress and HIF hypoxia transcriptional responses
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target programmes and regulation plus HIF oxygen sensing, hypoxia and glycolysis; having both NRF2 and HIF arms distinguishes it from HIF/p53/mTORC1, ROS-detoxification/ferroptosis and FOXO confusables.

qualifier: auditory and vestibular mechanosensation and hair-cell development
name: Auditory and vestibular hair-cell development and mechanosensation
rationale: Members cover hair-cell fate, stereocilia bundle assembly and sound and gravity/balance mechanotransduction; hair-cell function distinguishes it from inner ear morphogenesis and microvillus confusables.

qualifier: chemokine- and integrin-guided T cell homing
name: Chemokine- and integrin-mediated T cell migration and homing
rationale: Members concern chemokine-receptor signalling, integrin adhesion and T cell/lymphocyte homing; the T cell and integrin focus distinguishes it from lymphoid organ/B cell, monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1 and NK/DC chemotaxis confusables.

qualifier: tubulin glutamylation and severing in spermatogenesis
name: Tubulin glutamylation and microtubule remodelling in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members cover tubulin poly/deglutamylation, severing, depolymerisation and kinesins together with sperm mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier formation; these distinguish it from centrosome, ciliogenesis and axonemal dynein confusables.
